title: On a phone, a grouped list (`grouping`) keeps its desktop grid — titles cut mid-word, other columns behind the pinned Actions column — while the same console turns a plain list into cards
body:

`finding` class **a** · `reach:` public door: the console on `@objectstack/*` 18.2.0, measured in Chromium against the HotCRM seed.

## What is seen

As the service agent at 390×844, open HotCRM *Knowledge* (All Articles, `grouping: { fields: [category] }`). The grouped grid keeps its desktop columns: the header reads "Arti", titles are cut mid-word ("QA 2320 — Fixing a stucl", "Your First Week with the"), and every other column is off-screen behind the pinned Actions column (`phone-06-kb-list.png`). The Cases list on the same console becomes one card per row (`phone-02-all-cases.png`).

**Who loses:** any grouped list on a phone is unreadable.

## Expected

The grouped grid takes the same mobile card layout as the plain grid (group headers between the cards).

## Dedupe

`search_issues` objectstack "grouped grid list mobile card layout phone clipped columns": 0 hits.

**Reader who acts:** the console grid renderer owner.
